site_count_source: Own homepage https://www.airhop.co.uk/ park list: Aberdeen, Bicester, Birmingham, Blackpool, Bristol, Chelmsford, Colchester, Edinburgh, Enfield, Gloucester, Guildford, High Wycombe, Lincoln, Rotherham, Sheffield, Shrewsbury, Tunbridge Wells, Warwick, Westwood Cross, Wrexham
serving_basis: per serving where serving_size is a real weight/volume (e.g. pizza 645 g, chips 250 g, latte 275-375 ml); some rows are per 100 g (serving_size 100) and some have serving_size 0 or 1 or all-zero nutrition: a script must filter these; fields: calories, kJ, total_fat, saturated_fat, carbohydrates, sugar, fibre, protein, salt (+ allergens, mayContain, vegan/vegetarian, ingredients)
format: JSON (gzip) feed behind the chain's own allergen app (And It Has, Angular app); the chain's cafe page https://www.airhop.co.uk/airhop-cafe/ says 'For Allergens information, please click here' and links https://app.andithas.com/location/6d0dfab9-972c-4213-8cbb-70143416cc86
notes: Rendered the app with Playwright: item page shows 'Nutritional Information: Serving size 645 / Energy 6,878 KJ 1,644 kcal / Fat 61.1 g / saturate 30.9 / Carbohydrates 207.9 / sugars 13.9 / Fibre 12.0 / Protein 62.4 / Salt 6.3' for 'Stuffed Crust Pepperoni Pizza', plus allergens (contains, may contain). Feed holds 123 items in 13 sections (Breakfast 4, Pizzas 6, Jacket Potatoes 4, Hot Dogs 4, Wings 3, Toasties 7, Kids Meals 6, Sides 14, Snacks 14, Parties 5, Hot Drinks 25, Slush Drinks 18, Cold Drinks 13); 86 have calories > 0 and 61 have calories, protein, carbs and fat all > 0 (many of the rest are zero placeholders, e.g. Americano 0, Gluten Free Pepperoni Pizza 0). Mixed bases: 45 rows carry serving_size 100 (per 100 g/ml, not a serving) so only rows with a genuine serving weight are usable; the menu looks like one list for the whole chain (single app location UUID linked from the shared cafe page; menus may still differ by park, not checked). Allergens: yes, per item (allergens + mayContain). robots.txt: app.andithas.com 404 (no rules); live.menu.app.andithas.com and cdn.andithas.com answer 403 for robots.txt (treated as no rules per RFC 9309; flag for the founder's 403 policy). The And It Has platform may host other brands' nutritionals the same way (cdn.andithas.com/published/location/<uuid>.json + live.menu.app.andithas.com/<uuid>/menu.json).
